title: Process-oriented review
summary: Improvement accelerates when bad sessions are reviewed through controllable process errors instead of being reduced to rank, score, or self-judgment.
cues: Ask why the error happened, what the repeated pattern is, and how to test one fix next session
Keep one process goal visible during the block
Judge the session by execution quality before judging the score
failureModes: Treating one bad score day as evidence of regression
Stacking too many process goals at once after a poor session
